claim: Kandy District recorded 172,489 lifetime in-migrants and 287,823 lifetime out-migrants in the final 2024 census report, for a net balance of -115,334.

metric.denominator: lifetime migrants by district as defined by DCS
metric.basis: DCS final Census of Population and Housing 2024, Table 5.1.5
metric.source_definition: lifetime district migration; not annual net migration, city migration or graduate retention

bounded_by: Age cohort and education status are absent, so this cannot prove graduate brain drain; it is a warning against assuming retention success.
notes: Corrected in Run20 after the final DCS 2024 report superseded earlier persisted figures. The previous in 157,921 / out 282,795 / net -124,874 values and derived effectiveness ratio are retired.
